mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair liraglutide efficacy and increase hypoglycemia risk through altered renal clearance and glucose metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes, and blood glucose closely; consider temporary dose adjustment of liraglutide if significant nephrotoxicity or hypokalemia develops; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy.
